reference: Independently supplied fault-free source, fixed first seven source-clock calendar days, 2018-01-01 inclusive to 2018-01-08 exclusive. No later reference observations.
sampling: Retain exact existing observations whose source-clock minute and second equal zero. No averaging, interpolation, numeric conversion, timestamp shift or fabricated row. Full native-minute data separately inventoried and retained. This is a systematic hourly-observation benchmark, not exhaustive minute-resolution analysis.
signals: All 77 numeric signals, fixed consecutive source-header blocks of at most 32; 32/32/13. No outcome-dependent selection. Relationships across blocks are not evaluated.
invalid: Per block exclude rows with any blank, nonnumeric or nonfinite telemetry; record source row numbers. Never impute. Attempt all periods, including terminal partial period; preserve failures under 16 rows.
authority: Current app.engine.sii_engine.evaluate_sii supplied-reference historical interface; no config argument or analytical overrides; fresh engine-owned persistence and recurrence states per case and block, passed chronologically by value.
objective: Deterministic governed relationship evidence; no fault-label endpoint.
comparison: 720 paired calls: primary and repeat from fresh states/runtime, different Python hash seeds. Exact canonical semantic comparison of entire analysis_result, entire relationship_graph, supplied_reference, persistence and recurrence states, and whole engine result. Only declared runtime_metadata namespaces and versioned analysis_id/generated_at runtime aliases are excluded by production output_semantics.py. Lists retain order. No rounding or timestamp-name exclusions.
acceptance: 720/720 governed semantic outputs. Preserve all mismatches and errors. No comparator changes after execution.
baseline: Original v1 files and published 5/720 result immutable. v2 neither replaces nor regenerates v1.
ordering: Explicit source-column order and chronological observation order preserved. Neutral hourly CSVs reused byte-for-byte. CASE IDs inherited, labels neither opened nor supplied.
preservation: Complete engine returns saved in pickle+gzip checkpoints with input/state chain hashes; standard canonical JSON used for semantic digests. Pickle files are local trusted artifacts only.
implementation: Frozen remediation branch working tree; no analytical configuration overrides.
math_check: Compare every v2 primary relationship graph against its v1 counterpart, removing solely old runtime_seconds/new runtime_metadata envelope fields to bridge the runtime schema. Do not change v1 outputs or v1 comparator.
